project_info.theme: quiet gaze amid blurred city movement
project_info.color_palette: olive, muted teal, amber, charcoal, pale sky blue

main_subject.detail: An adult woman with long wind-tossed dark hair, natural makeup, and an oversized olive-green rain jacket.

items: moving crowd rendered as radial and lateral blur
dense city street with soft bokeh lights
covered olive outerwear dominating lower frame

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: teal-and-warm film grade, soft city haze, and documentary realism

technical_specs.render_style: handheld 50mm lens, f/2.0, slow shutter crowd blur with sharp locked focus on subject

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Candid street portrait of an adult woman centered sharply in a busy city crowd. Give her long windblown dark hair, natural makeup, and an oversized olive-green jacket. Surround her with anonymous pedestrians in slow-shutter motion blur; use a handheld documentary viewpoint, shallow depth of field, soft overcast daylight, cinematic teal-and-warm color grading, light bokeh, film grain, and an intense calm gaze. The visual idea is a frozen moment of stillness inside urban chaos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, recognizable bystanders, paparazzi harassment, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, text, logo
